findings.title: Partial publish leaves released packages depending on unpublished siblings
findings.label: valid
findings.note: With NPM_TOKEN removed, each package publishes only through its own Trusted Publisher, so a missing registration can partially publish packages that pin workspace:* siblings (protect->schema, prisma-next->stack), as the cited lines confirm.

findings.title: Floating npm@^11.5.1 install runs unpinned code in the OIDC-capable release job
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The PR adds a floating `npm install -g npm@^11.5.1` in a job with id-token: write, and that npm performs the publish: a newly introduced supply-chain exposure with a clear pinning mitigation.

findings.title: OIDC auth path not actually taken by changeset publish, so every publish still fails
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative: the finding concedes neither changesets/action .npmrc behavior nor pnpm-to-npm delegation was checked, the cited code shows no failing mechanism, and the consequence equals the base state.
